provenance.description: Recorded E/R/Z activations, 5 discrete dynamics steps. Three illustrative traces selected for a unique correct top-1 unfiltered entity readout and an inverse-relation candidate, ordered by readout margin. These examples are not aggregate evaluation results. All entity/relation activations are included; the display uses 24 of 110 Z columns. Connecting curves illustrate the selected pathway; they are not a complete weight matrix. No C-layer activations are present in these traces.
